This polygon shapefile is an index to the map series, '中支那五万分一 安徽省正陽關地方 -- 1:50,000 Naka Shina Anki-shō Seiyōkan chihō' (1943). Stanford University Libraries holds a large collection of Japanese military and imperial maps, referred to as gaihōzu, or 'maps of outer lands.' These maps were produced starting in the early Meiji (1868-1912) era and the end of World War II by the Land Survey Department of the General Staff Headquarters, the former Japanese Army. This layer provides an index map that can be used to locate individual scanned map sheets.
This item is in the public domain.  There are no restrictions on use.
